introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.description: BookingCare is committed to protecting the privacy and personal information of users. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our services.

informationCollection.title: 2. Information We Collect
informationCollection.subtitle: 2.1. Personal Information
informationCollection.description: We may collect the following information:

items.registrationValue: Full name, email, phone number, date of birth, gender
items.medicalValue: Medical history, appointment booking information, examination results (if you share)
items.paymentValue: Credit card information, bank account (processed by secure payment partners)
items.technicalValue: IP address, browser type, device used, location data

informationUsage.title: 3. Purpose of Information Use
items: Provide and improve medical appointment booking services
Send notifications about appointments, service updates
Comply with legal requirements and regulations

informationSharing.title: 4. Information Sharing
informationSharing.description: We do not sell or rent your personal information. We only share information in the following cases:

items.healthcareValue: Share necessary information to complete appointment booking services
items.partnersValue: Payment service providers, data storage, analytics (with confidentiality commitment)
items.legalValue: When requested by competent state agencies
items.protectionValue: To protect the rights, assets, or safety of BookingCare and users

userRights.title: 6. User Rights
userRights.description: According to legal regulations, you have the right to:

items.accessValue: Request to view your personal information
items.deleteValue: Request deletion of personal information (unless the law requires storage)
items.withdrawValue: Withdraw consent for processing personal data

userRights.contactEmail: To exercise the above rights, please contact us via email:

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.description: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience, analyze traffic, and personalize content. You can manage cookies through your browser settings.

storage.title: 8. Storage Period
storage.description: We store your personal information for the time necessary to fulfill the stated purposes or as required by law. After the storage period expires, information will be deleted or anonymized.

children.title: 9. Children Protection
children.description: Our services are not intended for children under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect information from children. If we discover children's information, we will delete it immediately.

policyChanges.title: 10. Policy Changes
policyChanges.description: We may update this privacy policy over time. Any changes will be announced on this website with the latest update date. We encourage you to regularly review this policy.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.description: If you have questions or concerns about this privacy policy, please contact:
